title: Explicit native new-execution launch association v2
description: Exact four-field canonical sorted compact ASCII JSON using the ensure_ascii codec, including DEL escaping, with no LF and at most 4096 original bytes. This artifact is selected only by the separately admitted native-egress-new-execution-v1 cold profile and a v4 egress grant. Schema validity or digest equality is not current filesystem/ELF/launcher custody, child creation, a start permit or runtime success. The old launch-manifest/v1 executable/argv/environment contract remains strict and is never synthesized for this profile.

launcherBinarySha256.description: Nonzero exact launcher-original pin. It must equal the separately signed workload.launcherBinarySha256 and the actual protected retained /proc/self/exe original; the path or a supplied success object cannot prove that identity.
